title: Fixed Three Sawtooth Roof and Open Factory Bay
description: One complete newly authored static sawtooth-roof factory bay. Three deep asymmetric sloping roof plates rise along the same axis to three separate full-height vertical clerestory strips. Thin finite opaque blue panes sit between actual sill, head and mullion members; exposed triangular end trusses have real open webs and stand on eight full-height columns over individual footings and a low floor. The open-sided volume and repeated slope-to-vertical cross section differ from the existing raised central monitor roof and from a single high curved hammerbeam portal: this is neither a recolored roof nor additional copies of a prior module. Every visible mesh is newly authored with complete closed thickness; no old model imported. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metre-style Z up, bounds-centred floor sole origin, one architectural model zero scenes. Static illustrative architecture only: blue panes are opaque visual infill, not simulated glazing. No daylight, heat, ventilation, drainage, weather sealing, span, strength, stability, structural load, attachment, dimensional interchangeability, installation, historical fidelity, building-code or safety guarantee. No enclosing walls, machinery, rigging, animation or interaction.
